summary:
Partial progress on the two fixes. Offline flow is clean (ZERO /api calls observed). Save-flow DID succeed once end-to-end: strokes drawn -> canvas-save-btn -> save-name-input filled 'TEST_Lotus' -> save-confirm-btn clicked (with force=True) -> canvas-toast 'Saved to gallery' shown -> localStorage.rangoli.artworks.v1 populated (512 bytes, 1 item) -> home-recent-{id} rendered -> persists after full page reload -> gallery-item-{id} visible -> tapping it reopens canvas with correct title 'TEST_Lotus' and strokes.

HOWEVER the LAYOUT bug is NOT fully fixed. On the second save attempt (update path from reopened artwork), Playwright now rejects the save-confirm-btn click with 'Element is outside of the viewport' even with force=True because getBoundingClientRect still reports {x:24, y:1620, w:342, h:52, vh:844} — the save button is 776px BELOW the viewport bottom. Same symptom as iteration_2. The Platform.OS==='web' ? View : KeyboardAvoidingView swap did NOT resolve it because the wrap style still has {flex:1, justifyContent:'flex-end'} inside a react-native-web Modal whose portal root does not provide a bounded viewport-height parent in this build — so flex:1 expands to content height (full sheet height ~228px pushed starting at y=1444). The Modal animates the slide-up visually, so a human user sees the sheet at the bottom of the screen; but DOM coords place every child outside viewport. First save only succeeded because Playwright's force click happened to dispatch (possibly via scrollIntoView collapsing the body); subsequent attempts fail deterministically.

ColorWheelSheet has the SAME root cause: the color-wheel View bounding rect is {x:55, y:1268, w:280, h:280} — the entire wheel is 424px below the viewport bottom. Tapping at mouse coords (within 390x844 viewport) never lands on the wheel element, so onResponderRelease never fires and color-wheel-hex stays at #FFFFFF across multiple tap attempts at different ring positions. The responder-based fix for locationX would work in principle, but the modal layout prevents the event from reaching the element in the first place. Grey swatch Pressables inside the sheet are presumably also outside viewport.

Net: both modals share one root cause — Modal content on web is laid out below viewport because the wrap flex:1 doesn't fill the viewport. Fix must bound the Modal content to window height on web (e.g. style={{position:'fixed', inset:0, display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', justifyContent:'flex-end'}} via Platform.select, OR use height:'100vh' / height: Dimensions.get('window').height). Deprecated react-native-web warnings 'shadow* deprecated' observed but non-blocking as instructed.

ui_bugs.issue: save-confirm-btn still rendered OUTSIDE viewport. Measured getBoundingClientRect {x:24, y:1620, w:342, h:52} on 390x844 viewport (inViewport=false). Even though wrap is now a plain <View> on web, styles.wrap {flex:1, justifyContent:'flex-end'} is not bounded to window height inside the Modal portal, so children lay out from the top at natural (content) height and push the sheet to document y=1444. First Playwright click occasionally succeeds via force=True; second always fails with 'Element is outside of the viewport'. End user sees it visually at bottom only because Modal slide animation transforms it, but the DOM coordinates are outside viewport. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SaveSheet.tsx:28-30, styles.wrap at :62. Suggested fix: on web wrap in a container with explicit height: window.innerHeight (or style={{position:'fixed',top:0,left:0,right:0,bottom:0,display:'flex',flexDirection:'column',justifyContent:'flex-end'}}) via Platform.select, OR drop Modal and render as absolute-positioned portal with position:'fixed', bottom:0.

color-wheel element itself is OUTSIDE viewport. Measured bbox {x:55, y:1268, w:280, h:280} on 390x844 viewport (bottom at y=1548, viewport bottom at y=844). Tapping at any (x,y) within viewport cannot reach the wheel so onResponderRelease never fires and color-wheel-hex stays at #FFFFFF through multiple tap attempts (ring edge, inner ring, outer ring). Same layout root cause as SaveSheet. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ColorWheelSheet.tsx:78-80 (styles.wrap flex:1, justifyContent:'flex-end' inside Modal).

issues: Modal content wrap style {flex:1, justifyContent:'flex-end'} does not reliably fill viewport height inside react-native-web Modal portal on this build. Needs explicit viewport-height bound on web (position:'fixed' + inset:0 OR height:100vh).

react_native_issues.component: SaveSheet / ColorWheelSheet Modal wrap on web
react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web Modal does NOT guarantee a viewport-height parent for its children; the common RN pattern of {flex:1, justifyContent:'flex-end'} to pin a bottom sheet works on native but collapses to content-height on web, pushing children below the fold. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SaveSheet.tsx:62 and /app/frontend/src/components/ColorWheelSheet.tsx:141
Non-blocking per instructions. 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' Warnings observed in console.

action_items: FIX modal viewport-height on web for BOTH SaveSheet and ColorWheelSheet: on Platform.OS==='web', wrap the sheet contents in a container with explicit viewport height. Simplest: replace styles.wrap on web with {position:'fixed', top:0, left:0, right:0, bottom:0, display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', justifyContent:'flex-end'} (or use Dimensions.get('window').height as height). Verify save-confirm-btn and color-wheel both have getBoundingClientRect().bottom <= window.innerHeight.
After fix, retest full chain: draw -> save -> toast -> home-recent -> reload persists -> gallery -> reopen -> update -> verify same id (no duplicate in localStorage array) -> delete -> gallery-empty.
After fix, retest color wheel: tap different rings -> color-wheel-hex updates -> apply -> canvas-custom-swatch appears.
critical_code_review_comments: SaveSheet.tsx and ColorWheelSheet.tsx share the same bottom-sheet layout pattern inside a react-native-web Modal — refactor into a shared BottomSheet component with web-safe viewport bounding.
api.ts update() correctly preserves id and only bumps updated_at — no-duplicate behavior is correct in code (not retestable through UI until save button is reachable twice).
ColorWheelSheet onStartShouldSetResponder/onResponderRelease pattern is correct for web locationX IF the event can reach the element; the current blocker is layout, not the responder code.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed ZERO /api calls across full flow. Offline storage (localStorage key 'rangoli.artworks.v1') works end to end for CREATE and PERSIST. Blocker is the Modal viewport-height on web — both SaveSheet (save-confirm-btn at document y=1620 on 844-tall viewport) and ColorWheelSheet (color-wheel at y=1268) render below the fold at the DOM level. Modal's slide animation makes it look correct visually, but DOM click/tap coords miss the targets. Fix once in both components (or extract shared BottomSheet) and retest the full update + delete + color-wheel chain. Note: a prior test iteration seed artwork TEST_Lotus (id mv3dlnzwzs1tsc) may remain in localStorage of the test browser — clear localStorage.removeItem('rangoli.artworks.v1') before retesting.
rca_of_issue: Shared RCA for both modals: Inside <Modal transparent animationType='slide'>, react-native-web renders children into a DOM subtree whose root does NOT get an explicit height on this build. The wrap style {flex:1, justifyContent:'flex-end'} therefore flex-grows against an unbounded parent, so flex:1 collapses to content height. The sheet's inner <View> with its own content height (~176px for SaveSheet, ~280+footer for ColorWheelSheet) stacks at the top of that content box, not at the bottom of the viewport. The Modal then applies a CSS slide-up transform for animation that visually puts the sheet at the bottom of the screen, but transforms are visual-only for user events in some cases and getBoundingClientRect in this react-native-web version appears to report pre-transform coordinates (verified: save-confirm-btn y=1620 while visually at ~y=792). Playwright and real pointer events dispatch at DOM coords, so taps outside viewport miss. Reproduction: open any sheet, run document.querySelector('[data-testid="save-confirm-btn"]').getBoundingClientRect() -> y is ~1620 on 390x844 viewport. Mitigation: give the Modal content an explicit window-height parent on web (position:'fixed' inset:0, or height:100vh via Dimensions). Previous fix (Platform.OS==='web' ? View : KeyboardAvoidingView) addressed symptom but not root cause — swapping KAV for View did not change the fact that flex:1 is unbounded in this portal.
